pipe_stage.title: Open pipeline by team
pipe_stage.description: Open EMEA opportunities closing this or next quarter, by owner role, manager, type, stage and rep forecast category, in incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, RecordType.Name recordType, StageName stage, Rep_Forecast_Category__c forecast, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) fq, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd, SUM(Incremental_Rep_Commit_ARR_USD__c) commitUsd, SUM(Incremental_Rep_Best_Case_ARR_USD__c) bestCaseUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, RecordType.Name, StageName, Rep_Forecast_Category__c, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) ORDER BY Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name LIMIT 2000

pipe_rep.title: Open pipeline by rep
pipe_rep.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell pipeline per rep for this and next quarter, in incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) fq, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) LIMIT 2000

pipe_pastdue.title: Past-due opps by rep
pipe_pastdue.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities whose close date has passed, per rep.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, COUNT(Id) pastDueOpps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) pastDueArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND CloseDate < TODAY AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name LIMIT 2000

pipe_stale.title: Stale opps by rep
pipe_stale.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities closing this or next quarter with no logged activity in 30 days, per rep.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, COUNT(Id) staleOpps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) staleArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND (LastActivityDate = null OR LastActivityDate < LAST_N_DAYS:30) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name LIMIT 2000

won_q.title: Closed won this quarter
won_q.description: EMEA closed-won opportunities this quarter (by the date they were actually closed, as in Bookings) by owner role, manager and type, in incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, RecordType.Name recordType, COUNT(Id) wonOpps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) wonArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsWon = true AND Actual_Close_Date__c = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, RecordType.Name LIMIT 2000

renew_stake.title: Renewals at stake
renew_stake.description: Open EMEA renewals closing this or next quarter by owner role, manager and stage, with the renewing contract ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, StageName stage, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) fq, COUNT(Id) renewals, SUM(Order_Form_ARR_USD__c) renewingArrUsd, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) netChangeArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name = 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, StageName, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) LIMIT 2000

cr_daily.title: Created opps per day
cr_daily.description: EMEA-owned opportunities created per day this quarter and last, by type, excluding renewals auto-created by Flow.

args.q: SELECT DAY_ONLY(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) day, RecordType.Name rt, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE (CreatedDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CreatedDate = LAST_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND (RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' OR Upsell_Renewal_Created_By__c != 'Flow') GROUP BY DAY_ONLY(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), RecordType.Name ORDER BY DAY_ONLY(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) LIMIT 2000

cr_monthly.title: Created opps per month
cr_monthly.description: EMEA-owned opportunities created per month over the last 12 months, by type, excluding renewals auto-created by Flow.

args.q: SELECT CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) yr, CALENDAR_MONTH(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) mo, RecordType.Name rt, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE (CreatedDate = LAST_N_MONTHS:12 OR CreatedDate = THIS_MONTH) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND (RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' OR Upsell_Renewal_Created_By__c != 'Flow') GROUP BY CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), CALENDAR_MONTH(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), RecordType.Name LIMIT 2000

cr_source.title: Created opps by source
cr_source.description: EMEA-owned opportunities created this and last quarter by type, lead source, creator role and originating BDR role.

args.q: SELECT CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) yr, CALENDAR_QUARTER(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) qtr, RecordType.Name rt, LeadSource leadSource, CreatedBy.UserRole.Name creatorRole, Originating_BDR_Role__c bdrRole, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE (CreatedDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CreatedDate = LAST_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND (RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' OR Upsell_Renewal_Created_By__c != 'Flow') GROUP BY CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), CALENDAR_QUARTER(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), RecordType.Name, LeadSource, CreatedBy.UserRole.Name, Originating_BDR_Role__c LIMIT 2000

cr_owner_q.title: Created opps by rep
cr_owner_q.description: EMEA opportunities created this quarter per owner and type, with how many a BDR sourced.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, RecordType.Name rt, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd, COUNT(Originating_BDR__c) bdrSourced FROM Opportunity WHERE CreatedDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND (RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' OR Upsell_Renewal_Created_By__c != 'Flow') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, RecordType.Name LIMIT 2000

cr_bdr.title: BDR-sourced opps
cr_bdr.description: Opportunities sourced by EMEA BDRs (BDR-EMEA and DIR-BDR-EMEA roles) this and last quarter, per BDR, whoever owns them; renewals auto-created by Flow left out.

args.q: SELECT CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) yr, CALENDAR_QUARTER(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) qtr, Originating_BDR__r.Name bdr, Originating_BDR__r.Manager.Name bdrManager, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE (CreatedDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CreatedDate = LAST_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND Originating_BDR_Role__c IN ('BDR-EMEA', 'DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND (RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' OR Upsell_Renewal_Created_By__c != 'Flow') GROUP BY CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), CALENDAR_QUARTER(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), Originating_BDR__r.Name, Originating_BDR__r.Manager.Name LIMIT 2000

rr_members.title: Routing pool members
rr_members.description: Members of every EMEA LeanData round-robin pool, with the member's role, active flag, status and when they were added.

args.q: SELECT LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c poolName, LeanData__OwnerId__c userId, LeanData__User_Owner__r.Name userName, LeanData__User_Owner__r.UserRole.Name userRole, LeanData__User_Owner__r.IsActive userActive, LeanData__Status__c memberStatus, MIN(CreatedDate) addedOn FROM LeanData__Round_Robin_Setting__c WHERE (LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%EMEA%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%MEA%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Baltics%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Benelux%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%CEE%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%DACH%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Germany%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%France%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Italy%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Iberia%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%LATAM%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Nordics%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Southern Europe%' OR LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE 'RR Gov:%') GROUP BY LeanData__Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c, LeanData__OwnerId__c, LeanData__User_Owner__r.Name, LeanData__User_Owner__r.UserRole.Name, LeanData__User_Owner__r.IsActive, LeanData__Status__c LIMIT 2000

rr_assign.title: Routing assignments, 90 days
rr_assign.description: Leads and records LeanData assigned through each EMEA pool per member in the last 90 days (counts only).

args.q: SELECT LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c poolName, LeanData__Round_Robin_Chosen_OwnerId__c userId, COUNT(Id) assignments, MAX(CreatedDate) lastAssigned FROM LeanData__Log__c WHERE LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__c != null AND CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:90 AND (LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%EMEA%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%MEA%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Baltics%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Benelux%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%CEE%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%DACH%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Germany%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%France%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Italy%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Iberia%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%LATAM%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Nordics%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE '%Southern Europe%' OR LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c LIKE 'RR Gov:%') GROUP BY LeanData__Round_Robin_Pool__r.LeanData__Grouping_Name__c, LeanData__Round_Robin_Chosen_OwnerId__c LIMIT 2000

roster.title: EMEA sales roster
roster.description: Every Salesforce user in an EMEA sales role (UK&I excluded), active or not, with manager and created date.

args.q: SELECT Id userId, Name name, UserRole.Name role, Title title, Manager.Name manager, IsActive isActive, Legora_Start_Date__c startDate, DAY_ONLY(CreatedDate) createdDate FROM User WHERE UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Id, Name, UserRole.Name, Title, Manager.Name, IsActive, Legora_Start_Date__c, DAY_ONLY(CreatedDate) LIMIT 2000

users_all.title: Salesforce users
users_all.description: Every active standard Salesforce user, any role, with email and manager. Used to match HiBob people to Salesforce by email.

args.q: SELECT Id userId, Name name, Email email, UserRole.Name role, Manager.Name manager FROM User WHERE IsActive = true AND UserType = 'Standard' GROUP BY Id, Name, Email, UserRole.Name, Manager.Name LIMIT 2000

hb_people.title: EMEA GTM people (HiBob)
hb_people.description: Everyone on headcount in HiBob's GTM EMEA, Engagement EMEA and Growth EMEA departments, with work email, title, team, site, manager and start date.

bk_owner.title: Account book per owner
bk_owner.description: Accounts and customer ARR (USD) owned by each EMEA rep, by account status.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, Owner.IsActive active, Account_Status__c status, COUNT(Id) accounts, SUM(ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Account WHERE Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, Owner.IsActive, Account_Status__c LIMIT 2000

bk_pipe.title: Open pipeline per owner
bk_pipe.description: All open opportunities per EMEA owner and type, any close date, in incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, RecordType.Name motion, COUNT(Id) openOpps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) openArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, RecordType.Name LIMIT 2000

bk_em.title: Engagement manager books
bk_em.description: Customer accounts and ARR (USD) per EMEA engagement manager (the account's Engagement Manager field).

args.q: SELECT CSM__r.Name em, CSM__r.UserRole.Name emRole, CSM__r.Manager.Name emManager, CSM__r.IsActive emActive, COUNT(Id) accounts, SUM(ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Account WHERE CSM__r.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND Account_Status__c = 'Customer' GROUP BY CSM__r.Name, CSM__r.UserRole.Name, CSM__r.Manager.Name, CSM__r.IsActive LIMIT 2000

bk_terr.title: Territory coverage
bk_terr.description: Accounts and ARR (USD) in each EMEA sales region (incl. LATAM) by owner role and account status.

args.q: SELECT Sales_Region__c salesRegion, Owner.UserRole.Name ownerRole, Account_Status__c status, COUNT(Id) accounts, SUM(ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Account WHERE Sales_Region__c IN ('Northern Europe','FME','DACH','Iberia','Southern Europe','MEA','LATAM') GROUP BY Sales_Region__c, Owner.UserRole.Name, Account_Status__c LIMIT 2000

bk_orphans.title: Orphan accounts
bk_orphans.description: Active accounts (customer, pipeline, engaging, or with ARR) in EMEA regions whose owner is inactive, has no role, is RevOps or sits outside EMEA.

args.q: SELECT Id accountId, Name account, Owner.Name owner, Owner.IsActive ownerActive, Owner.UserRole.Name ownerRole, BillingCountryCode country, Sales_Region__c salesRegion, Account_Status__c status, SUM(ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Account WHERE Sales_Region__c IN ('Northern Europe','FME','DACH','Iberia','Southern Europe','MEA','LATAM') AND (Account_Status__c IN ('Customer','Pipeline','Engaging') OR ARR_USD__c > 0) AND (Owner.IsActive = false OR Owner.UserRoleId = null OR Owner.UserRole.Name = 'REVOPS' OR (NOT Owner.UserRole.Name LIKE '%EMEA%')) GROUP BY Id, Name, Owner.Name, Owner.IsActive, Owner.UserRole.Name, BillingCountryCode, Sales_Region__c, Account_Status__c ORDER BY SUM(ARR_USD__c) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1500

bk_books.title: Account books by owner
bk_books.description: Accounts per account book (Territory ID) and owner, for accounts in an EMEA sales region (LATAM included).

args.q: SELECT Territory_ID__c book, Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name ownerRole, Owner.IsActive ownerActive, COUNT(Id) accounts, SUM(ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Account WHERE Territory_ID__c != null AND Sales_Region__c IN ('Northern Europe','FME','DACH','Iberia','Southern Europe','MEA','LATAM') GROUP BY Territory_ID__c, Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.IsActive LIMIT 2000

closed_rep.title: Closed won and lost
closed_rep.description: EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities closed won or lost this quarter and last (by the date they were actually closed), per owner, type and lost reason.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, RecordType.Name rt, IsWon won, Closed_Reason__c lostReason, FISCAL_YEAR(Actual_Close_Date__c) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(Actual_Close_Date__c) fq, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = true AND (Actual_Close_Date__c = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR Actual_Close_Date__c = LAST_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, RecordType.Name, IsWon, Closed_Reason__c, FISCAL_YEAR(Actual_Close_Date__c), FISCAL_QUARTER(Actual_Close_Date__c) LIMIT 2000

cr_owner_m.title: Created opps per rep per month
cr_owner_m.description: EMEA-owned opportunities created per owner per month over the last 6 months and this one, with the first one each month (Flow renewals excluded).

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) yr, CALENDAR_MONTH(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)) mo, RecordType.Name rt, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd, MIN(CreatedDate) firstCreated FROM Opportunity WHERE (CreatedDate = LAST_N_MONTHS:6 OR CreatedDate = THIS_MONTH) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND (RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' OR Upsell_Renewal_Created_By__c != 'Flow') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, CALENDAR_YEAR(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), CALENDAR_MONTH(convertTimezone(CreatedDate)), RecordType.Name LIMIT 2000

pipe_nextstep.title: Next-step dates
pipe_nextstep.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities closing this or next quarter with no next-step date or an overdue one, per owner and quarter.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) fq, COUNT(Id) flaggedOpps, COUNT(Next_Steps_Date__c) overdueOpps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) flaggedArrUsd, MIN(Next_Steps_Date__c) oldestOverdue FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND (Next_Steps_Date__c = null OR Next_Steps_Date__c < TODAY) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) LIMIT 2000

pipe_slips.title: Close-date moves, 30 days
pipe_slips.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities whose latest close-date change was in the last 30 days, per owner, by the quarter the date moved from and to.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, FISCAL_YEAR(LastCloseDateChangedHistory.PrevCloseDate) fromFy, FISCAL_QUARTER(LastCloseDateChangedHistory.PrevCloseDate) fromFq, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) toFy, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) toFq, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd, SUM(Close_Quarter_Push_Count__c) quarterPushes FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND LastCloseDateChangedHistory.CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:30 AND LastCloseDateChangedHistory.PrevCloseDate != null GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, FISCAL_YEAR(LastCloseDateChangedHistory.PrevCloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(LastCloseDateChangedHistory.PrevCloseDate), FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) LIMIT 2000

pipe_edits.title: Close-date edits, 30 days
pipe_edits.description: Close-date edits on open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities in the last 30 days, per owner, including repeat edits of the same deal.

args.q: SELECT Opportunity.Owner.Name owner, COUNT(Id) closeDateEdits, COUNT_DISTINCT(OpportunityId) oppsEdited, MAX(CreatedDate) lastEdit FROM OpportunityFieldHistory WHERE Field = 'CloseDate' AND CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:30 AND Opportunity.IsClosed = false AND Opportunity.RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND Opportunity.Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Opportunity.Owner.Name LIMIT 2000

pipe_early.title: Early-stage deals this quarter
pipe_early.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities closing this quarter that are still at stage 0 or 1, per owner.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND (StageName LIKE '0%' OR StageName LIKE '1%') AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name LIMIT 2000

pipe_nocontact.title: Deals with no contact role
pipe_nocontact.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities closing this quarter with no contact role, per owner.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, COUNT(Id) noContactOpps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) noContactArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND Id NOT IN (SELECT OpportunityId FROM OpportunityContactRole) GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name LIMIT 2000

top_deals.title: Largest open deals
top_deals.description: The 300 largest open EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities closing this or next quarter, with owner, stage, close date, forecast category, next step and its date, last activity, days in the current stage and age.

args.q: SELECT Id oppId, Name opp, Account.Name account, Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, StageName stage, RecordType.Name rt, CloseDate closeDate, Rep_Forecast_Category__c forecast, NextStep nextStep, Next_Steps_Date__c nextStepDate, LastActivityDate lastActivity, DAY_ONLY(CreatedDate) createdDate, MAX(LastStageChangeInDays) daysInStage, MAX(AgeInDays) ageDays, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name != 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Id, Name, Account.Name, Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, StageName, RecordType.Name, CloseDate, Rep_Forecast_Category__c, NextStep, Next_Steps_Date__c, LastActivityDate, DAY_ONLY(CreatedDate) ORDER BY SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 300

top_renewals.title: Largest open renewals
top_renewals.description: The 300 largest open EMEA renewals closing this or next quarter by renewing contract ARR, with prior ARR, net change, stage, forecast, next step and last activity.

args.q: SELECT Id oppId, Name opp, Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, StageName stage, CloseDate closeDate, Rep_Forecast_Category__c forecast, NextStep nextStep, LastActivityDate lastActivity, SUM(Order_Form_ARR_USD__c) renewingArrUsd, SUM(Existing_ARR_USD__c) existingArrUsd, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) netChangeArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name = 'Renewal' AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Id, Name, Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, StageName, CloseDate, Rep_Forecast_Category__c, NextStep, LastActivityDate ORDER BY SUM(Order_Form_ARR_USD__c) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 300

deals.title: Open deals of one person
deals.description: Every open opportunity (any type and close date, up to 200) owned by the person open in the person panel.

args.q: SELECT Id oppId, Name opp, Account.Name account, StageName stage, RecordType.Name rt, CloseDate closeDate, Rep_Forecast_Category__c forecast, NextStep nextStep, Next_Steps_Date__c nextStepDate, LastActivityDate lastActivity, MAX(LastStageChangeInDays) daysInStage, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd, SUM(Order_Form_ARR_USD__c) contractArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND OwnerId = {{dealOwnerId}} GROUP BY Id, Name, Account.Name, StageName, RecordType.Name, CloseDate, Rep_Forecast_Category__c, NextStep, Next_Steps_Date__c, LastActivityDate ORDER BY CloseDate ASC LIMIT 200

gr_notes.title: Granola meeting notes
gr_notes.description: Your Granola meetings in the chosen window (notes you took or were invited to), with up to three attendees' emails; the page then reads each note and keeps every line of its summary and private notes, with the headings above it.

mv_outcomes.title: Won and lost, last 7 days
mv_outcomes.description: EMEA New Business and Upsell deals closed won or lost in the last 7 days (by the date actually closed; admin merges and record clean-ups left out of lost), per owner, in incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, IsWon won, COUNT(Id) n, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arr FROM Opportunity WHERE RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND IsClosed = true AND Actual_Close_Date__c = LAST_N_DAYS:7 AND (IsWon = true OR Closed_Reason__c NOT IN ('Merged with Global Pilot','Record cleanup')) GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, IsWon LIMIT 2000

mv_created.title: Created, last 7 days
mv_created.description: EMEA New Business and Upsell opportunities created in the last 7 days, per owner and the fiscal quarter they close in, in incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) toFY, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) toFQ, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arr FROM Opportunity WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:7 AND RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) LIMIT 2000

mv_close.title: Close dates moved across this quarter, last 7 days
mv_close.description: Close-date changes in the last 7 days on open EMEA New Business and Upsell deals created before the window that moved a deal out of this quarter or into it, one row per deal and from/to fiscal quarter with the first and last time it happened, the current owner and the deal's current incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT OpportunityId oppId, Opportunity.Owner.Name owner, Opportunity.Owner.UserRole.Name role, Opportunity.Owner.Manager.Name manager, FISCAL_YEAR(PrevCloseDate) fromFY, FISCAL_QUARTER(PrevCloseDate) fromFQ, FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate) toFY, FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) toFQ, MIN(CreatedDate) firstAt, MAX(CreatedDate) lastAt, MAX(Opportunity.Finance_ARR_USD__c) arr FROM OpportunityHistory WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:7 AND Opportunity.RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND Opportunity.Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND Opportunity.IsClosed = false AND Opportunity.CreatedDate < LAST_N_DAYS:7 AND ((PrevCloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER AND (CloseDate > THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate < THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER)) OR ((PrevCloseDate > THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR PrevCloseDate < THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER)) GROUP BY OpportunityId, Opportunity.Owner.Name, Opportunity.Owner.UserRole.Name, Opportunity.Owner.Manager.Name, FISCAL_YEAR(PrevCloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(PrevCloseDate), FISCAL_YEAR(CloseDate), FISCAL_QUARTER(CloseDate) LIMIT 2000

mv_fields.title: Stage and Commit changes, last 7 days
mv_fields.description: Stage and rep forecast category changes in the last 7 days on open EMEA New Business and Upsell deals created before the window, one row per change, with the deal's owner and current incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT OpportunityId, Opportunity.OwnerId, Opportunity.Finance_ARR_USD__c, Field, OldValue, NewValue, CreatedDate FROM OpportunityFieldHistory WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:7 AND Field IN ('StageName','Rep_Forecast_Category__c') AND Opportunity.IsClosed = false AND Opportunity.CreatedDate < LAST_N_DAYS:7 AND Opportunity.RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND Opportunity.Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') ORDER BY OpportunityId, CreatedDate, Id LIMIT 2000

age_stuck.title: Stuck deals by rep
age_stuck.description: Open EMEA New Business and Upsell deals closing this or next quarter that have sat in their stage longer than about twice the usual time (stage 0: 35 days, 1: 55, 2: 60, 3: 40, 4: 30, 5: 45, 6: 40), per owner and stage.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, StageName stage, COUNT(Id) stuckOpps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) stuckArrUsd, AVG(LastStageChangeInDays) avgDaysInStage, MAX(LastStageChangeInDays) maxDaysInStage FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER) AND RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND ((StageName = '0 - Qualification' AND LastStageChangeInDays > 35) OR (StageName = '1 - Solution agreement' AND LastStageChangeInDays > 55) OR (StageName = '2 - Scope agreement' AND LastStageChangeInDays > 60) OR (StageName = '3 - Pilot Validation' AND LastStageChangeInDays > 40) OR (StageName = '4 - Commercial agreement' AND LastStageChangeInDays > 30) OR (StageName = '5 - Vendor assessment' AND LastStageChangeInDays > 45) OR (StageName = '6 - Opt-out' AND LastStageChangeInDays > 40)) AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, StageName LIMIT 2000

cycle_team.title: Sales cycle by team
cycle_team.description: EMEA New Business and Upsell deals won in the last 4 completed quarters per owner role, manager and type, with the average and longest days from creation to close.

args.q: SELECT Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, RecordType.Name rt, COUNT(Id) wonOpps, AVG(Days_from_Created_to_Close_Date__c) avgCycleDays, MAX(Days_from_Created_to_Close_Date__c) maxCycleDays, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) wonArrUsd FROM Opportunity WHERE IsWon = true AND RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND Actual_Close_Date__c = LAST_N_FISCAL_QUARTERS:4 AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, RecordType.Name LIMIT 2000

coverage_base.title: Bookings history and open pipeline
coverage_base.description: EMEA New Business and Upsell won and lost in the last 4 completed quarters and this one (admin merges left out of lost), and open pipeline closing this and next quarter (deals past due from earlier quarters left out, as on Pipeline), per owner role, manager and fiscal quarter, in incremental ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, IsClosed closed, IsWon won, FISCAL_YEAR(Actual_Close_Date__c) fy, FISCAL_QUARTER(Actual_Close_Date__c) fq, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arr, COUNT(Id) n FROM Opportunity WHERE RecordType.Name IN ('New Business','Upsell') AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND (IsClosed = false OR IsWon = true OR Closed_Reason__c NOT IN ('Merged with Global Pilot','Record cleanup')) AND ((IsClosed = true AND (Actual_Close_Date__c = LAST_N_FISCAL_QUARTERS:4 OR Actual_Close_Date__c = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER)) OR (IsClosed = false AND (CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER OR CloseDate = NEXT_FISCAL_QUARTER))) GROUP BY Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, IsClosed, IsWon, FISCAL_YEAR(Actual_Close_Date__c), FISCAL_QUARTER(Actual_Close_Date__c) LIMIT 2000

bk_stale.title: Untouched active accounts
bk_stale.description: Active accounts (customer, pipeline, engaging) of EMEA owners with no logged activity in 90 days or ever, per owner and status, with how many were ever touched and how many have an Engagement Manager.

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, Account_Status__c status, COUNT(Id) accounts, COUNT(LastActivityDate) everTouched, COUNT(CSM__c) withEm, SUM(ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Account WHERE Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND Account_Status__c IN ('Customer','Pipeline','Engaging') AND (LastActivityDate < LAST_N_DAYS:90 OR LastActivityDate = null) GROUP BY Owner.Name, Account_Status__c LIMIT 2000

bk_em_cover.title: Engagement Manager coverage
bk_em_cover.description: Customers of EMEA owners grouped by their Engagement Manager's role and whether that user is active (blank when there is none), with customer ARR (USD).

args.q: SELECT Owner.Name owner, CSM__r.UserRole.Name emRole, CSM__r.IsActive emActive, COUNT(Id) customers, COUNT(CSM__c) withEm, SUM(ARR_USD__c) arrUsd FROM Account WHERE Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') AND Account_Status__c = 'Customer' GROUP BY Owner.Name, CSM__r.UserRole.Name, CSM__r.IsActive LIMIT 2000

lv_opps.title: Open deals owned by people who left
lv_opps.description: Open opportunities of every type whose owner is an inactive Salesforce user with an EMEA role, per owner and type: how many, incremental ARR and contract ARR (USD), and the next close date.

args.q: SELECT OwnerId ownerId, Owner.Name owner, Owner.UserRole.Name role, Owner.Manager.Name manager, RecordType.Name rt, COUNT(Id) opps, SUM(Finance_ARR_USD__c) arrUsd, SUM(Order_Form_ARR_USD__c) contractArrUsd, MIN(CloseDate) nextClose FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND Owner.IsActive = false AND Owner.UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA') GROUP BY OwnerId, Owner.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, RecordType.Name LIMIT 2000

lv_leads.title: Open leads owned by people who left
lv_leads.description: Leads that are neither converted nor disqualified whose owner is an inactive Salesforce user with an EMEA role, counted per owner and status.

args.q: SELECT OwnerId ownerId, Status status, COUNT(Id) leads FROM Lead WHERE IsConverted = false AND Status NOT IN ('Disqualified','Converted') AND OwnerId IN (SELECT Id FROM User WHERE IsActive = false AND UserRole.Name IN ('AE-EMEA-FR','AE-EMEA-DACH','AE-EMEA-SOUTH','AE-EMEA-CEE','AE-EMEA-BENELUX','AE-EMEA-MEA','AE-EMEA-IBERIA-LATAM','AE-EMEA-NORDICS','SMB-EMEA','EM-EMEA','EM-EMEA-LATAM','BDR-EMEA','DIR-SALES-EMEA','MGR-SALES-EMEA','VP-SALES-EMEA','DIR-EM-EMEA','DIR-BDR-EMEA')) GROUP BY OwnerId, Status LIMIT 2000

cal_events.title: Your calendar, next 14 days
cal_events.description: Your Google Calendar events from today for the next 14 days (regular events only), with who is invited; the page keeps the 1:1s with a colleague.

sf_me.title: You in Salesforce
sf_me.description: Who you are in Salesforce (user, role, title and manager), so the team scorecard can start from your own direct reports.
